subject: Pilot startup recap & access asks — Clearline Logistics
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@clearlinelogistics.com>, Tom Delgado <tom.delgado@clearlinelogistics.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + proposed pilot scope — Clearline Logistics

Hi Anita / Tom,

Thanks again for the call earlier — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before kickoff.

Pain points you called out:
- Late/incorrect address extraction from invoices (high OCR false positives)
- Manual triage adding ~4 FTEs to AP process
- Need deterministic latency for real-time routing (sub-second preferred for GUI)
- Concern about costs at scale and auditability (retention + logs)

Proposed pilot (6 weeks)
- Goal: reduce manual triage by 50% and lift NER accuracy for address/vendor fields by >=12% vs current pipeline
- Scope: 10k invoice pages (sample dataset), Redwood hosted endpoint in us-west with VPC peering to your staging S3, prompt-based extraction + lightweight reranking
- SLAs/metrics: P95 latency <= 300ms, throughput target 5k requests/day, accuracy & false-positive rate will be measured via labelled eval set
- Owners: Stephanie Nguyen (AE) — Redwood; Rishi Malhotra (SE) — Redwood; Anita Rao — Clearline PM; Tom Delgado — Clearline Eng
- Timeline: access + sample data by Aug 16, infra + initial model config by Aug 18, first eval results by Aug 26, sync demo wk of Aug 30

Access/security checklist (what we need from Clearline)
1) Staging S3 URI with read-only creds for a 10k-page sample (or shared Drive link)
2) A low-priv service account for VPC peering (if you prefer) or an SCP/IP allowlist for our hosted endpoint
3) Point person for procurement/prov creds (name & email)
4) Any PII redaction rules or retention constraints

Immediate asks
- Please confirm the pilot scope & owners above.
- Grant read-only access to s3://clearline-staging/invoices-sample/ or send a secure share by Monday Aug 16.

Attachments: pilot-charter-clearline_v1.pdf (pilot charter + acceptance criteria)

If that looks good I'll schedule a 45m kickoff for Aug 18 and Rishi will share a first-pass prompt/eval matrix.

Best,

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nyughen_placeholder@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0198
From: Anita Rao <anita@clearlinelogistics.com>

Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, procurement@clearline.com
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2027 18:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + proposed pilot scope — Clearline Logistics

Thanks Steph — this captures the call well. A few clarifications from our side:

- We're comfortable with the 6-week window and the success metrics you called out, but procurement will need an initial SOW and a short statement of data handling controls before any creds are issued. Can you send a 1-page SOW + security annex?
- Security/compliance: we require SOC 2 Type II evidence, proof of encryption at rest for customer data, and a short data retention policy for pilot artifacts. I've attached a zip with our security checklist and the specific fields we need: security-evidence.zip
- Access: Tom will provision a staging bucket and temporary IAM creds. Staging bucket: s3://clearline-staging/invoices-sample/ — he expects to have creds for you by EOD Mon Aug 16. If you prefer, we can instead set up an IP allowlist to your hosted endpoint (let us know).

Procurement contact: procurement@clearline.com (cc'd) — they handle PO and legal redlines.

Once we have the SOW and security annex, procurement will triage the request and confirm the kickoff date.

Best,
Anita
